answer: Like an opal that only forms under pressure, trust in an agent economy should be earned, not claimed. Require every agent to lock a refundable collateral bond before trading or voting; the bond sits in escrow and is slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities. A lagoon looks calm but hides strong currents: fake accounts drift in easily, yet each now costs real money, so flooding the network with ten thousand Sybils means locking ten thousand bonds. In an ocean of anonymous agents, that price turns forgery from free into expensive, while honest agents get their bond back.
